pages.text: Sea Magic involves, the crafting, working, and enchanting of jewelry. There are various enchants that are unique to jewelry. In here you can find instructions on how to craft the jewelry and how to enchant it as well as information on the various different enchantments that your pieces can have.
pages.title: Introduction

pages.text: Jewelry is put on and taken off in a Mirror: place it in the ring, bracelet or necklace slot.$(br2)Blink is the only enchantment with a key (V by default; change it in Controls).
